summary: This component renders a form for creating an event with fields for location, description, faculty co-ordinator, and an event image. It includes input fields for each field, a text area for the description, and a file input for the event image. The form also includes a submit button that changes its text based on whether the event is being created or submitted.
evidence: The component renders a form with input fields for location, description, faculty co-ordinator, and an event image.
The form includes a submit button that changes its text based on whether the event is being created or submitted.
The component includes a file input for the event image, which displays the selected image name if an image is uploaded.
